title: Exceptional inverse image on a closed affine-space chart
statement:
Let $k$ be a field of characteristic $p>0$, let $\ell\ne p$ be prime, let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be finite and put $A=\mathcal O_E/t^n$ for a uniformizer $t$ and $n\geq1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a $k$-morphism between separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $v:V\hookrightarrow Y$ and $u:U\hookrightarrow X$ be affine open subschemes such that $f(U)\subseteq V$. Suppose $i:U\hookrightarrow P=\mathbf A^r_V$ is a closed immersion, $r\geq0$, and $fu=v\pi i$, where $\pi:P\to V$ is the projection [def-sbc-affine-space]. Let $f_A^\times$ be the ordinary etale right adjoint to $Rf_{!,A}=Rg_{*,A}j_!$ for a compactification $f=gj$ [def-amb-etale-compact-support, thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint]. Use ordinary etale module derived categories, bounded constructibility and Tor amplitude [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes, def-kun-tor-amplitude]. There is a canonical counit-preserving natural isomorphism on the entire ordinary derived categories
$$u^*f_A^\times L\simeq Ri_A^!\bigl(\pi^*v^*L(r)[2r]\bigr),$$
where $Ri_A^!$ is the right adjoint of the exact closed pushforward [lem-exc-closed-ambient], and $(r)$ is the ordinary etale Tate twist of [thm-amb-vector-bundle-purity]. For every bounded constructible finite-Tor $L$ on $Y$, the expression on the right is bounded constructible and has finite Tor amplitude on $U$. No boundedness of $f_A^\times L$ is assumed in forming the isomorphism.

proof.text: Apply [lem-pur-etale-chart-compact-support-normalization] to the chart and its canonical complementary open W. Project its annihilator ell^n A=0 and the finite-type/separated/quasi-compact structure-map consequences. Finiteness and the local instances in ClosedChartExceptionalPreservation are installed by their recorded constructions; unfold that outer predicate first to expose those instances. The explicit definition closedChartCompactSupportComparison is the normalized unbounded comparison λ. The comparison assertion itself quantifies over arbitrary F and adjF; it does not require making another choice of exceptional inverse image.

source.place: Locality and Charts; domain and left-compositor lemma

proof.text: The prime ell differs from the characteristic p, so ell^n is a unit in k; mapping through the spectrum global-sections isomorphism and the structure morphism makes it a unit on V. Apply [cor-amb-affine-space-adjunction] with N=ell^n, A the coefficient quotient, S=V and d=r. A proved private helper states its right functor using closedChartTwistedPullback and supplies the nonempty adjunction. For every adjF and every adjπ, compose the open-source adjunction with adjF, and the closed ambient adjunction with adjπ and the target-open adjunction [lem-exc-closed-ambient, lem-cat-right-adjoint-composition]. Transport the first composite left functor along closedChartCompactSupportComparison. Mathlib Adjunction.rightAdjointUniq compares the two right adjoints on the entire derived categories; an explicit associator groups the right adjoints as in the statement.

source.place: Locality and Charts; unbounded Hom chain

proof.text: For the transported composite adjunction adj₁ and the closed/purity/open composite adj₂, Mathlib Adjunction.rightAdjointUniq_hom_app_counit gives J(e_L);epsilon₂=epsilon₁. Precompose with the hom of closedChartCompactSupportComparison; the inverse comparison in epsilon₁ cancels, giving precisely the asserted counit equation. For uniqueness, apply the injective inverse hom-equivalence of adj₂ objectwise and cancel the comparison isomorphism. The counit equation then forces every component; natural-transformation extensionality and Iso.ext force equality of isomorphisms. No boundedness or choice of normalization is used, so this applies to every supplied purity adjunction. The public predicate counitNormalizedChartComparison abstracts exactly this unique-isomorphism assertion over the chart functors. ClosedChartExceptionalAssertion packages the same three clauses as a Prop structure; these representation changes avoid expensive kernel reduction and introduce no mathematical assumption.

source.place: Existence, uniqueness, naturality; pasted counit calculation

proof.text: Enlarge an arbitrary Tor interval [a₀,b₀] to the ordered interval [min a₀ b₀,max a₀ b₀]. Apply the last clause of [lem-sp-etale-pullback-twist-tor-window] along v to preserve bounded constructibility and this Tor interval. View v*L in the bounded derived category using its cohomological bounds; apply [lem-sp-etale-scalar-flat-model] for A→A to get a flat constructible representative in the same interval. Apply the first clause of [lem-sp-etale-pullback-twist-tor-window] along π with twist r and shift 2r. Its result is definitionally the object closedChartTwistedPullback(v*L), bounded constructible with interval [a-2r,b-2r]. Apply [lem-pur-etale-arbitrary-field-open-complement-control] to the canonical complement W and its inclusion, using the finite-type and quasi-compact consequences of the chart normalization. Choose its uniform dimension bound d and obtain HasOpenComplementCondition at 2d. The standard derived-functor D+-compatibility transports both clauses to the unbounded single-sheaf presentation required by [prop-exc-closed-tor]. That theorem gives bounded constructibility and Tor interval [a-2r,b-2r+2d+1] for the actual chosen closed right adjoint. This proves the last conjunct independently of the counit comparison.

lean.note: Ordinary small-etale module categories throughout. The closed-chart expression is literal exact pullback, recorded finite Tate twist, shift and the recorded closed right adjoint. The canonical natural iso is stated choice-independently for every ambient right-adjoint presentation and every purity adjunction, hence in particular for the integration-normalized adjunction of thm-amb-vector-bundle-purity; uniqueness is fixed by the full pasted-counit equation relative to the specified compact-support comparison.
